articles.title: Infant Among 4 Dead as Car Swept Into Canal in Rain-Hit Haldwani
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | A car carrying 7 people, including a 4-day-old infant, plunged into a rain-swollen canal. 4 lost their lives, 3 critically injured.

body.html:
#InShort | A car carrying 7 people, including a 4-day-old infant, plunged into a rain-swollen canal. 4 lost their lives, 3 critically injured.

* * *

Haldwani (Uttarakhand) – Four people, including a four-day-old infant, lost their lives after a car plunged into a rain-swollen roadside canal on Wednesday. The accident occurred amid heavy rainfall in the region, causing water levels to rise dangerously.

The car, carrying seven passengers, got stuck under a culvert after being swept away by the strong current. Water quickly flooded the vehicle, trapping all occupants. Rescue teams broke the windshield to retrieve the victims. Four were declared dead, and three others remain critically injured at Sushil Tiwari Hospital.

City SP Prakash Chandra confirmed that the car was swept away by the current and efforts are on to gather further details. Haldwani Municipal Commissioner Richa Singh said emergency teams are on standby, and citizens have been advised to avoid flooded zones and overflowing drains.

articles.excerpt: Rohtak (Haryana) – A tragic case of alleged harassment and emotional blackmail has surfaced after Magan alias Ajay, a resident of Rohtak, ended his life by hanging himself from a tree.

body.html:
Rohtak (Haryana) – A tragic case of alleged harassment and emotional blackmail has surfaced after Magan alias Ajay, a resident of Rohtak, ended his life by hanging himself from a tree. Before dying, he recorded a painful selfie video, accusing his wife Divya and her alleged lover, a police officer named Deepak, of mental torture.

In the video, Magan claims Divya sent him intimate videos with Deepak, pushed him to sell his property, and falsely implicated him in his father’s death. He said he gave ₹3.5 lakh after selling his bracelet and crops, but was being forced to pay another ₹1.5 lakh.

Magan pleaded for laws to protect men, stating that society only sympathises with crying women, not suffering men. He requested that his son be raised by his parents.

Police have launched an investigation based on the viral video and family complaints.

articles.title: Dalit Men Forced to Eat Grass, Crawl 2 KM in Odisha – “Cow Protectors” or Extortionists?
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Berhampur (Odisha) – Two Dalit men in Ganjam district were brutally assaulted, half-tonsured, and humiliated by a mob on suspicion of cattle smuggling.

body.html:
Berhampur (Odisha) – Two Dalit men in Ganjam district were brutally assaulted, half-tonsured, and humiliated by a mob on suspicion of cattle smuggling. The victims, Babula Nayak (54) and Bulu Nayak (42), were transporting two cows and a calf as a wedding gift when self-styled 'cow protectors' intercepted them at Kharigumma village.

The mob allegedly demanded ₹30,000, and upon refusal, forced them to crawl on their knees for over 2 km, eat grass, and drink drain water. Videos of the incident went viral, sparking statewide outrage.

Police have detained six persons so far and are searching for others. Ganjam SP said the motive was not cow protection but extortion. The victims have been treated at Dharakote CHC.

Dalit organisations and political leaders condemned the caste-based violence, demanding strict action. Former Odisha PCC chief Niranjan Patnaik criticised CM Naveen Patnaik’s silence on the issue.
